pages.text:
A solid box of Superheater Array Casings, 3 to 7 blocks each way. It takes steam and heat in and sends the next steam grade out.
- Steam → High-Pressure costs 3 HU per mB, High-Pressure → Superheated 3, Steam → Superheated 6.
- Boiling plain Steam and superheating it is the cheapest way to Superheated Steam (14 HU per mB against 16 from a boiler alone), and only the superheater needs 900 °C heat.
- Its own heat must reach the target's temperature: 500 °C for High-Pressure, 900 °C for Superheated. Colder, steam passes through unchanged.
- The Pressure tab picks the target: Auto (the best its heat allows), High-Pressure or Superheated.
- Per 27 blocks of its size: up to 1,000 mB/t and 2,000 HU/t, a 200,000 HU buffer and 16,000 mB tanks for steam in and out. A 7×7×7 moves 12,700 mB/t, enough for the biggest turbine.
- A 3×3×3 is drawn as one machine; a bigger box is one connected casing, run from its lowest north-west corner.
# Ports
A new array has none: set steam in, steam out and heat in with the Wrench in Port mode.
